description: This Java class 'AndroidDomExtender' extends 'DomExtender' to provide custom extension registration for Android XML DOM elements within an IDE or tooling environment. It handles registration of attributes, subtags, and special cases for Android layout, drawable, transition, manifest, and animation XML elements, facilitating IDE features like code completion and validation.

classes.name: AndroidDomExtender
classes.description: A class extending 'DomExtender' to register custom attribute and subtag extensions for Android XML DOM elements, supporting IDE features like code completion and validation for Android layout, drawable, transition, manifest, and animation XML files.

classes.name: MyCallback
classes.description: A helper class providing callback methods for processing attributes and subtags during extension registration.

classes.name: MyAttributeProcessor
classes.description: An interface defining a method for processing attribute extensions.

classes.name: MyRequired
classes.description: An implementation of 'Required' annotation indicating an attribute is mandatory.

classes.name: MyStopException
classes.description: A runtime exception used to control flow during recursive extension registration.

methods.name: registerExtensions
methods.description: Main method to register attribute and subtag extensions for a given Android DOM element, based on its type (manifest, layout, animation, drawable, transition, etc.).

methods.name: registerExtensionsForXmlResources
methods.description: Registers extensions for XML resource elements, handling special tags like 'searchable', 'Keyboard', 'device-admin', and preferences.

methods.name: registerExtensionsForDrawable
methods.description: Registers extensions for drawable-related XML elements, including state lists, layers, and animations.

methods.name: registerExtensionsForTransition
methods.description: Registers extensions for transition-related XML elements, such as 'fade', 'set', 'auto-transition', and 'targets'.

methods.name: registerExtensionsForAnimator
methods.description: Registers extensions for animator XML elements, including 'set' and specific styleables.

methods.name: registerExtensionsForManifest
methods.description: Registers extensions for manifest XML elements, handling styleables and attributes, including static and dynamic elements.

methods.name: processAttrsAndSubtags
methods.description: Processes attributes and subtags for a given Android DOM element, invoking specific registration routines based on element type.

methods.name: registerAttributes
methods.description: Registers attribute extensions for styleables, classes, or specific attribute definitions, with support for converters and soft registration.

methods.name: getStyleables
methods.description: Retrieves styleable definitions by name from attribute definitions.

methods.name: getSuperclass
methods.description: Returns the superclass of a given PsiClass within a read action.

methods.name: registerLayoutAttributes
methods.description: Registers layout-specific attributes for a class and its superclasses.

methods.name: registerClassNameSubtags
methods.description: Registers subtags for class names, avoiding abstract classes and handling qualified names.

methods.name: registerSubtags
methods.description: Registers subtags with a callback, filtering allowed tags.

methods.name: registerExistingAttributes
methods.description: Registers existing attributes from an XmlTag, adding their definitions to the extension system.
